description: Search INKEEDecoder for cosmetic products using the advanced filter: match a name and/or require and forbid specific ingredients. Use it for questions like "moisturizers with squalane and no fragrance". Returns one page of products — each response says whether another page is available. Read-only.

exclude.description: Ingredients the product must not contain, using the site's display names — for example ["Fragrance", "Alcohol Denat."].

include.description: Ingredients the product must contain, using the site's display names — for example ["Squalane", "Tocopherol"]. Take these from an ingredient page's name, not from an INCI list.

include_mode.description: `all` (default) requires every `include` ingredient; `any` requires at least one.

page.description: 1-based page number. Each response states whether another page is available.

query.description: Free-text part of the search: a product or brand name. Leave empty to filter purely by ingredients — but then pass `include` or `exclude`.

name: inkeedecoder_search_products

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

title: Search products by ingredient
